name: Vanishing Act
summary: A magic show 404 page: the curtains part, card 404 vanishes in smoke, and you pick a card to reveal a page
about: A full not-found page for a magic theatre, with velvet curtains, footlights, a spotlight that follows your pointer and a top hat on a draped table. The curtains part, a wand taps the floating 404 card and it vanishes in a puff of smoke, then a fan of playing cards rises out of the hat, each one a page of the site. Pick a card or name it in the search and it spins up into the spotlight with doves, falling suits and a Take me there link.
how: The curtains part, the spotlight snaps on and the wand makes card 404 vanish
Pick a card, any card, from the fan; it spins into the spotlight and asks Is this your card?
Type in Name your card and press Reveal to call up any page, even one not in the fan
Press Take me there to open it, or Shuffle again to gather the deck into the hat and deal again
Tap the top hat for a rabbit with a tip; sparkles trail your mouse across the stage
It plays a short demo by itself until you click or type
